statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0253 is fixed in lru 0.18.2, but aws-sdk-s3 (a direct vector dependency for the aws_s3 source/sink) pins lru ^0.16.3, so cargo update to 0.18.2 fails dependency resolution. Remediation is blocked until aws-sdk-rust/smithy-rs relaxes the lru requirement.
